p3.caveat: Evaluated on 25 synthetic English speech queries. Recovered cases without timing are strictly excluded from latency statistics.

p4.title: Audio-Visual Fusion Lab

statisticalTest.conclusion: The difference between Native Omni (25/40) and Modular (28/40) was NOT statistically significant (exact McNemar p = 0.25). Modular superiority cannot be claimed.

spatialSubsetFailure.condition: Unanswerable spatial relation queries (e.g. absent objects)
spatialSubsetFailure.explanation: When asked about spatial relations that did not exist in the frame (e.g. top_right_absent), models tended to hallucinate colors/shapes instead of acknowledging absence (both only 4/16 on this subset).

temporalPilot.finding: Four-case video pilot scored temporal ordering 2/4. Temporal alignment across synchronized audiovisual streams was not independently established.

p4.caveat: Paired advantage was not statistically significant (p = 0.25). Synthetic holdouts do not establish general real-world AV fusion.

p5.title: Decision Intelligence & Confidence Lab

audioDecision.name: P5.6b Audio vs Transcript Oracle
audioDecision.note: 12/12 audio vs 12/12 text oracle. Synthetic test; text oracle does not independently establish ASR reliability.

prominentFailureX03.implication: Model emitted ~92% confidence on a completely wrong category (billing instead of technical), passing the post-hoc 0.90 threshold. Proves confidence is NOT production-calibrated.

p5.caveat: Confidence values are exploratory and not production calibrated. Human review remains mandatory for consequential actions.

p6.title: Unified Multimodal Orchestration

Local CPU execution or sequential pipeline
Validated payload returned with trace metadata

p6.assertionClarification: The 90/90 score measures software regression assertions across router, state transitions, and IPC endpoints. It is NOT a semantic model reasoning accuracy score.
p6.caveat: Sequential pipelines incur model-switching latency on single-engine CPU hosts.

crossPhaseSynthesis.name: Synthetic Document OCR
crossPhaseSynthesis.keyObservation: Direct pipeline avoids downstream token exhaustion cascades; 1.7x faster median latency.

crossPhaseSynthesis.name: Speech-to-Speech Streaming
crossPhaseSynthesis.keyObservation: Native S2S cuts latency by 30-50% while modular enables stage inspection and guardrails.

crossPhaseSynthesis.name: Paired AV Fusion Holdout
crossPhaseSynthesis.keyObservation: Modular +3 edge is NOT statistically significant (p = 0.25). Unanswerable queries fail in both.

coreConclusions.title: Direct vs Modular Trade-off
coreConclusions.body: Direct end-to-end models eliminate intermediate token serialization bottlenecks and downstream cascade failures, whereas modular pipelines expose inspectable stages and enable targeted safeguards.

coreConclusions.title: Multimodal Spatial & Temporal Boundaries
coreConclusions.body: Both native and modular pipelines struggled with unanswerable spatial relationships and temporal video alignment in the exploratory pilots, frequently hallucinating plausible attributes.

coreConclusions.title: Confidence Miscalibration
coreConclusions.body: High reported model confidence (~92%) can accompany completely erroneous predictions (Case X03), underscoring that raw softmax/decision probabilities must not authorize unreviewed autonomous actions.

coreConclusions.title: Deterministic Routing Utility
coreConclusions.body: Zero-overhead set-theoretic capability routing effectively matches diverse multimodal queries to specialized models without requiring non-deterministic LLM meta-agent reasoning.
